extraction_notes: Main-paper figures with dense time-series or Arrhenius rate points (Fig. 1b full point-by-point traces, Fig. 5a rate-vs-temperature data) were not fully digitized; only clearly stated text/table values and unambiguous major plotted points were extracted. Supplementary figures/tables are referenced by the paper but were not included in the supplied text and therefore were not extracted. Literature-comparison rows in Table 2 from other papers were excluded; only 'This work' rows were retained. Selectivity basis was not defined in the supplied main text, so it is marked unspecified.
